intro.text: A Coinshot of the Set who goes by the name Push, sent to work with the Vanishers alongside his partner Pull.

items.text: Push worked with a Lurcher nicknamed Pull; the two dressed alike and teamed up on heists and other jobs. When Mister Suit left the city, he left the pair behind to help Miles Dagouter.

Annoyed that Miles warned them so late that Wax was hidden in the Breaknaught, Push chased Wax up the Ironspine Building with Pull, Pushed Vindication from his hands and shot him in the arm before Wax sent him flying. Once Marasi shot Pull dead, Push came back and went after her for revenge, then confirmed Pull's death to Miles.

Unsure how to beat Push, Wax realized he could fire a Coinshot hazekiller round with a Steelpush in place of a gun. When Push tried to Push it back, its ceramic tip kept going and struck him in the eye, killing him.

personality.text: Push is serious in manner and talks in an almost flat monotone.

items.text: A Coinshot, Push is a skilled Allomancer and gunman who flies gracefully and easily turns bullets aside, and he came close to killing Wax.
